notes.title: Fix for Freezing Issue
notes.content: We have fixed an issue where the game could freeze during play when using the latest version of the Steam SDK. Additionally, minor bug fixes and performance improvements have been made.

notes.title: Crash Fix
notes.content: Fixed some crash issues in Windows

notes.title: Reduced the memory usage
notes.content: Good news! Bear's Restaurant eats up less RAM. Which means it becomes less likely to crash the game. We hope nothing breaks though...

notes.title: Fixed crashes after watching the ending
notes.content: Bugs were reported on SteamDeck that crashes after the first ending. We fixed the crash. Please let us know if you're still having any trouble. We'll fix them asap! We will make sure to check the threads every day this week. Thank you very much for your patience and thank you very much for players who helped us investigating the problem.

notes.title: Fixed a crash on SteamDeck/Linux
notes.content: There was a problem launching the game. We made a temporary fix to make it work.

notes.title: Improved lil birdy's voice sound.
notes.content: Now it sounds like it is chirping ♪

notes.title: Winter Sale!
notes.content: Thank you very much for your support in 2022! This will be the final sale for Bear's Restaurant & FishingParadiso this year. Happy holidays and enjoy the new year!

notes.title: Spinoff-Sequel "Fishing Paradiso" Coming to Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41022205/dc0431276aaff947331f60a49e81f1c2508e65f2.png[/img]

We're happy to announce that the popular Bear's Restaurant spinoff title, Fishing Paradiso, will arrive on Steam early next year! It's a pixelated tropical adventure starring you and everyone's favorite loudmouth bird!

And that's not all! There are a TON of other returning characters from Bear's Restaurant you can befriend in Fishing Paradiso, so fans of the former are sure to get even more enjoyment out of the latter!

Check out the store page for more details: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1781030/

notes.title: Bear's Restaurant is a touching game that looks worth your time
notes.content:
Bear's Restaurant is one we missed from early October. It involves the afterlife, with you landing a job at the afterlife’s coziest eatery.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/11/bears-restaurant-is-a-touching-game-that-looks-worth-your-time

notes.title: Version 1.1 Update!
notes.content:
Hey there, everyone! How have you been enjoying your time with Bear's Restaurant so far? We've got a pretty tasty update for you today!

So basically, we've received some reports from players and reviewers regarding the game's English translation quality.  

As a small Japanese indie studio, we really appreciate feedback like this, because we want to make sure our loyal English-speaking players are getting the best experience possible.

To that end, we've brought on a professional translator with more than half a decade of industry experience, including acclaimed projects like the highly successful Muv-Luv Series Kickstarter campaign. 

He's been a passionate fan of Odencat's games for years, and will be working closely with us to ensure that our English translations are up to a professional quality standard while also adhering more closely to the spirit of our original vision.

Today, we're pushing a comprehensive text update for Bear's Restaurant that implements thousands of corrections and improvements to things like:

[list]
[*]Incorrect grammar
[*]Improper punctuation/capitalization
[*]Mistranslations
[*]Overall dialogue flow
[*]Inconsistent terminology
[*]Overall stylization and aesthetics
[*]Emotional punch
[/list]
..and much more!

While many of these fixes were minor and won't be too noticeable, we promise it'll make for a much better player experience overall! We highly recommend checking it out, even if you've already played through Bear's Restaurant before!

Here's a little taste for you:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41022205/7eb4c04b8a75f8ccafa1562770f841e6053f8219.jpg[/img]

In addition to all of the text revisions, this update also fixes a few technical and graphical bugs. We will also be updating the Switch and Mobile versions of the game with these new improvements in the near future.

Again, thanks so much for supporting our very first Steam release!
We've got many more games cooking in the oven that we can't wait to share with you!

notes.title: New Key Art and the launch information
notes.content:
Ah... We don't know how to use the news feature of Steam yet, but we'll try our best! 

[b]Here is the news[/b]
The new key art of Bear's Restaurant is available! While we are proud of our pixel art in Bear's Restaurant, we always wanted to have an official key art like this. Finally, we have one! We hope you like this heartwarming hand-drawn bear and cat!

[b]Regarding the game launch[/b]
The game is being reviewed right now, which means, the launch date is around the corner!
We hope everything goes well and the game becomes available to you very soon.
